mu_name_from: OpenMU VersionSeasonSix's CreateArmor (openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/VersionSeasonSix/Items/Armors.cs:87); the model is Player/HelmMale26.bmd, which MuMain's OpenItems loads for it (MuMain/src/source/Engine/Object/ZzzOpenData.cpp:213).

stats.call_note: CreateArmor(number, slot, width, height, name, dropLevel, defense, durability, levelRequirement, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, energyRequirement, vitalityRequirement, leadershipRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel, magicGladiatorClassLevel, darkLordClassLevel, summonerClassLevel, ragefighterClassLevel, isShield), openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Items/ArmorInitializerBase.cs:367.

why_this_one: The Dark Lord's first set, Light Plate (docs/plans/dark-lord.md section 7; OpenMU's rows, drop 42-62, lords only). The user, 2026-10-25: 'Scepters and DL gear', then 'next'.
sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py under MU's own names with a lightplate_ prefix, MU's _17 names being generic: dark steel plate lacquered blue-green, trimmed in silver.
material_note: painted_steel with the cast grain for the plate, the shading painted on, as the other sets.
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V; on plate it drew vertical streaks (studio, 2026-10-04). plate_steel's cast grain instead, shallow for the gloss, as the other sets.
effects_note: MuMain has no render arm for MODEL_LIGHT_PLATE_* (no glow, no chrome pass, no sprite; grep of _enum.h:1667 and MODEL_HELM..BOOTS + 25). Its refine colour is PartObjectColor 11, (0.35, 0.35, 0.6) (ZzzObject.cpp:6739, 6789; src/game/shine.cpp); its full set the generic aura (fx/set_shine).
tiled_why: An added sheet needs its own material (Wing04, Helper01): the hair_R shell, which MU draws added.
additive_from: A texture named _R is MuMain's Bright mesh (TextureScript.cpp:31-40), RenderBody making it its own BlendMesh (ZzzBMD.cpp:2236-2242): the white hair drawn added.
glow_note: A Dark Lord's helm lights its blend mesh at sin(WorldTime*0.001)*0.1 + 0.7 (ZzzCharacter.cpp:9608-9610): the hair breathing between 0.6 and 0.8.
separate_meshes_why: The hair shell, the face and the mask are three meshes; kept apart so the hair is not welded into the head.
cull_from: As HelmClass05: MU's hair is flat single-sided fins, and culled they wink out as the head turns.
face_note: level_man02 is MuMain's own Dark Lord skin (256x256), the face under the mask; the bare body wears S17's HQlevel_man02. MuMain's own kept, its UVs being this model's.
